completion_requirements: Both dataset results_v2 complete.json report PASS_NSG_GT_M5_NATIVE_FULL_PLAIN_SAMPLED_COUNT_LINEAR_ORACLE_V2 before reading/using new quality.
Formal frozen scope: two datasets x K in {1,100} x L in {200,400,800,1000,1200} x {NSG,GT,M5}=60 points, 180 full timing rounds; no new training or table selection.
WebVid uses all public 10000 queries; Yandex uses the first 10000 of public 100000. Preserve query identity, historical public exposure and no blind-IID guarantee.

Recall uses each full 10000-query return packet; NDC/count parity and post stats use fixed 256 uniformly spaced query IDs. Never label sample NDC as full-batch NDC.
QPS includes full formal normal body, allocation/init/release, routes, original scalar main search and every M5 guard/lookup/dedup/rescore/merge/output cost. Loading and audits are separate.

Figures derive only from final analysis_v2 metrics.json with no new searches and no interpolated performance claim.
